hill_hold_brake_min — DRIVE long op

• Data kinds: scalar → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.hill_hold_brake_min(theta: 'float', c_rr: 'float' = 0.012, a_creep: 'float' = 0.0, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import drivelong; drivelong.hill_hold_brake_min(theta: 'float', c_rr: 'float' = 0.012, a_creep: 'float' = 0.0, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("hill_hold_brake_min"))

Usage

Minimum braking [m/s²] that keeps the car standing on a slope = max(0, |a_creep − g sin θ| − c_rr g cos θ) (static friction balance).
